Subject: Quote request: plumbing in Austin, TX

Hello Barton Creek Plumbing,

I am contacting you on behalf of a customer who needs plumbing in Austin, TX. This request is prepared and sent by an automated assistant; if you would rather not be contacted this way again, reply saying so and we will stop.

The job: Replace a 50 gallon gas water heater in a garage; the old unit is leaking at the base.
Timing: weekday mornings, week of 2026-11-09
Budget: up to 2500 USD

Could you tell us:
1. Your price for this job, and whether it is a fixed quote, an estimate or an hourly rate.
2. Your earliest availability within the timing above.
3. What the price includes (parts, materials, disposal, warranty).
4. Anything you need from the customer (access, permits, a deposit, a site visit first).

We are only collecting quotes at this stage; the customer decides on any booking. Please reply by 2026-11-04T17:00:00Z.

reply.text: Thanks for reaching out. We can replace the 50 gallon gas unit for $1,980 total, which includes the new heater, parts and labor, permit and haul-away of the old unit. We are available Tuesday 2026-11-10 at 8am. We will need access to the garage and a working gas shutoff.
